messages:
maya: FYI — partner analytics wants a per-API-key override so their internal service can burst during ETL windows. They asked for 10x burst for 2 hours. Not comfortable shipping that without controls.

sasha: Agree we need a safe pattern. Two immediate concerns: (1) audit + approval for overrides, (2) telemetry so we can see when overrides are used and the impact on latency/cost.

raj: Proposal: Add an "override profile" concept in the console that is temporary by default. Fields: target key, burst_tokens, sustained_rate, expires_at, reason, approver. Only SRE or Platform Eng can grant.

olivia: UX idea: in the console, expose an "Request override" button from a key's details page that pre-fills a request modal. The modal captures reason, TTL (max 24h), and selects approver group. Requests go to an approver queue (Slack + email).

maya: +1 to TTL and approver queue. Also suggests we should support short-lived programmatic grants (top-up vouchers) for automation, not just manual console flow.

deploy-bot: NOTE: existing rate limiter supports token-bucket with burst and refill. We can add an "override_id" metadata field that increments a counter and appears in logs when override is applied.

raj: On enforcement: prefer server-side evaluation against key metadata so nothing bypasses it. Pseudocode: 

```
if key.override && now < override.expires_at:
  enforce(burst=override.burst_tokens, rate=override.sustained_rate)
else:
  enforce(default_policy_for_key)
```

olivia: For telemetry: expose per-key metrics: current_burst_tokens, refill_rate, override_active{override_id}, override_expiry_seconds. Push to prometheus and add a console chart for top 10 keys by override consumption.

security-team: We need an audit trail with who approved, reason, and changes. Also require justification for >4x bursts. Keep hard limits: no single override can exceed X tokens (we define X later).

maya: Can we tie approvals to IAM groups? e.g., approver must be in "platform-approvers" SSO group. That reduces manual steps.

raj: Yes, RBAC integration straightforward — approver field is validated against SSO groups at approval time. We'll store approver id in override metadata.

judy: Operational concern: what happens if a key with active override is used across regions? We need cross-region sync of override state or local fallbacks. Maybe replicate override metadata to each serving region with eventual consistency.

raj: We can add override TTL and a generation id. Serving nodes refresh override table every 10s and fall back to non-overridden policy if unknown — but that may cause spikes. Alternative: push updates via control plane pub/sub for near-real-time.

olivia: UI/Console: Add a timeline on the key page showing override events (requested, approved, activated, expired) and link to audit log entry. Provide a one-click revoke for approvers.

maya: For partner SLAs — propose we let Dedicated tenants request permanent higher tier instead of repeated overrides. Overrides are for short emergency/maintenance ETL windows only.

security-team: Add automated post-mortem hook — if an override caused >5% latency regression across a region, trigger an eval + incident review.

maya: Action items: (1) raj implement override metadata + server-side enforcement prototype (owner raj) (2) olivia wireframe request/approve modal + timeline view (owner olivia) (3) sasha add prometheus metrics and grafana panel (owner sasha) (4) judy draft RBAC + approver group policy (owner judy) (5) security-team to set hard caps and approval rules (owner security-team).

raj: I'll prototyping token-bucket override id and pub/sub sync. Will post RFC link when ready.

olivia: I'll mock the modal tomorrow and attach screenshots to the RFC.

maya: Thanks — let's aim to have RFC in two weeks. If anyone needs to escalate partner urgent request in the meantime, ping me and include expected impact and a reason. :thumbsup:
